title: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is facing a new wave of lawsuits from eight US states that accuse the company of harming children and misleading customers about the safety of ChatGPT, as reported earlier by Reuters . The lawsuits, filed separately by Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho, and Montana, allege OpenAI unlawfully put profits over safety when developing ChatGPT. summary: 美国八个州（爱荷华、堪萨斯、内布拉斯加、西弗吉尼亚、阿肯色、亚利桑那、爱达荷、蒙大拿）分别对 OpenAI 提起诉讼，指控其将利润置于安全之上，未充分警示 ChatGPT 对未成年人的风险，违反各州消费者保护法。这是继多起青少年相关诉讼后，针对 OpenAI 的最大规模州级法律行动，可能推动全美 AI 未成年人保护立法加速。

title: Now that Character.AI is going bankrupt, what happens to all of its users’ data?
raw_excerpt: New York Attorney General Letitia James revealed a years-long multi-state investigation against Character.AI as they now seek to require protections on consumer data sold through its bankruptcy proceeding. James is among 40 bipartisan AGs who filed a notice of interest in Character.AI's bankruptcy case "to put all parties on notice of the regulatory issues that will need to be addressed in any sale or transfer of the Debtor's business or assets." Character.AI announced Tuesday it was filing for Chapter 11 and selling some assets to Disney. But the AGs warn there could be serious risk involved in the transfer of the technology due to the "hi … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Character.AI 宣布申请 Chapter 11 破产并拟将部分资产出售给迪士尼，纽约州总检察长联合 40 位两党州检察长向破产法院提交利益通知，要求对用户数据在出售或转移中施加保护。这标志着 AI 陪伴类产品积累的海量敏感对话数据首次进入破产处置程序，其数据归属与隐私处理将成为行业先例。

title: OpenAI claims an ex-employee took its product plans and presented them to Apple
raw_excerpt: OpenAI claims a former employee took more than 100 files related to its product plans before joining Apple. In a document filed on Wednesday , OpenAI accuses the unnamed employee of sending this information to a personal account and then presenting it to Apple leadership, including the vice president of the company's operations in Asia. The filing, reported earlier by Reuters , is tied to a legal battle between Apple and OpenAI over trade secrets - but this time, OpenAI is doing the accusing. It alleges that the files in question contain images of at least one unreleased device, along with supplier information, engineering data, project files … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: OpenAI 在法庭文件中指控一名前员工离职加入苹果前，将 100 多份涉及未发布产品的机密文件发送至个人账户，并向苹果亚洲运营副总裁等高管展示。此事与苹果和 OpenAI 之间的商业秘密诉讼相关，但此次由 OpenAI 主动指控，凸显两家公司在 AI 硬件与终端入口上的竞争已延伸至法律战。

title: Microsoft has a new machine learning tool to improve weather forecasts
raw_excerpt: Old-school physics-based weather forecasting and even new AI models typically become less reliable beyond two weeks, a problem Microsoft claims to have solved using machine learning. Researchers with the company say they've found a new, cost-effective way to make more accurate weather forecasts two to six weeks in advance - allowing farmers and emergency responders to plan ahead with greater certainty. The findings were published today in the journal Nature , and the tool is now open-source software . Microsoft joins Google , Nvidia , and other companies developing AI tools for weather forecasting. Instead of creating a new standalone weather  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 微软研究院在《Nature》发表成果，利用机器学习显著提升 2 至 6 周中长期天气预报的准确性，突破传统物理模型与现有 AI 模型两周后精度骤降的瓶颈，并已将工具开源。该成果对农业、应急响应等依赖中长期预测的场景具有直接价值，也延续了 Google、Nvidia 在 AI 气象领域的竞争。

title: Gemini 4 Argon Lands on Google Cloud
raw_excerpt: Google made Gemini 4 Argon available on Google Cloud as a frontier model for long, multi-step enterprise work. It was positioned for tasks requiring sustained context and domain expertise, including software development, finance, legal work, and cybersecurity.
summary: Google 将前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon 上线 Google Cloud，定位为面向长周期、多步骤企业任务的模型，覆盖软件开发、金融、法律和网络安全等需要持续上下文与领域专业知识的场景。这是 Google 在 Anthropic、OpenAI 密集发布后重新加码企业级 AI 市场的关键动作，也回应了此前外界对其落后的质疑。

title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B
raw_excerpt: LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a 24B-parameter reasoning model with 2B active parameters, is designed for fast, private on-device agents. It outperforms or matches larger models like Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on five out of eight benchmarks and runs up to 1.7x faster due to its efficient architecture. Available on Hugging Face, it supports extensive inference frameworks, making it suitable for tasks needing swift local inference and tool usage.
summary: Liquid AI 发布 LFM2.5-24B-A2B，总参数 24B、激活参数仅 2B 的推理模型，面向快速、私密的端侧智能体。官方称其在八项基准中的五项超过或持平更大的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，运行速度最高快 1.7 倍，已在 Hugging Face 开放并支持多种推理框架。小激活参数路线正成为端侧 Agent 的重要技术方向。

title: NVIDIA Run:ai Is Now Open Source as Part of NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform
raw_excerpt: Nvidia is making the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform available as open-source software. It is now possible for every NVIDIA DSX ecosystem partner and AI cloud to increase workload throughput, improve GPU utilization, and operate shared AI infrastructure more efficiently and effectively. The release includes the complete NVIDIA Run:ai platform, KAI Scheduler, GPU Fractioning Operator, KAI Resource Management, and Workload Map. Platform teams and ecosystem partners can adopt NVIDIA Run:ai as an integrated whole, build on it for their own products and services, or integrate individual components based on their requirements.
summary: Nvidia 宣布将完整 Run:ai 平台开源，作为 DSX AI Factory 平台的一部分，包含 KAI Scheduler、GPU Fractioning Operator、KAI Resource Management 和 Workload Map 等组件。生态伙伴与 AI 云可直接采用整体方案或集成单个组件，以提升 GPU 利用率和共享 AI 基础设施效率。此举有望降低企业自建 AI 调度栈的门槛。

title: Frontier Models for Every Robot
raw_excerpt: Physical Intelligence is making its latest models available for training and inference through the Pi API beta. The Pi API adapts the latest and most powerful robotic foundation models to each application, dealing with ML infrastructure, compute, and complex data pipelines. Users just upload data, launch fine-tuning on managed compute and infrastructure, and access the fine-tuned models via a hosted gateway to run inference.
summary: 机器人基础模型公司 Physical Intelligence 推出 Pi API 测试版，将其最新机器人基础模型开放用于训练与推理。用户只需上传数据，即可在托管算力上启动微调，并通过托管网关调用微调后的模型，无需自建 ML 基础设施与复杂数据管线。这标志着机器人基础模型正从实验室走向标准化 API 服务。

title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
raw_excerpt: Learn how Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore uses lightweight on-device Gemma models to intercept conversational scams in private chats with zero cloud data egress.
summary: Google DeepMind 与新加坡政府科技局合作，基于轻量级端侧 Gemma 模型构建针对会话式诈骗的检测方案，可在私人聊天中实时拦截诈骗且数据零上云。该合作将前沿模型能力与国家级反诈需求结合，为隐私敏感场景下的端侧 AI 落地提供了可复制的政企协作范式。

title: OpenAI Employee Arrested Over Hidden Recording Device
raw_excerpt: OpenAI said it alerted the FBI after finding a hidden recording device in an executive conference room, leading to the firing and arrest of employee Abdulrahman Alfozan. Prosecutors alleged the device was used to covertly intercept conversations, while OpenAI said it found no evidence that model weights, source code, or customer data were accessed.
summary: OpenAI 披露在一间高管会议室发现隐藏录音设备后通知 FBI，涉事员工 Abdulrahman Alfozan 已被解雇并遭逮捕。检方称该设备用于秘密截取对话，OpenAI 表示未发现模型权重、源代码或客户数据被访问的证据。此事凸显头部 AI 实验室内部安全与商业秘密防护面临的现实威胁。
